REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, September 19, 2017 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk

a.

d.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
8.
PUBLIC HEARING - CONSIDERATION OF SITE PLAN REVIEW NO. 1182 AND TENTATIVE PARCEL MAP NO. 74637 FOR A MULTI-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL PROJECT CONSISTING OF TWO TOWNHOUSE UNITS AT 2374 247TH STREET (Filed by Tom Yuge, 2225 W. Carson Street, Suite B Torrance, CA 90501)
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
Res 2017-33 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita approving Vesting Tentative Parcel Map No. 74637 for the subdivision of a single 11,313 square foot lot into two separate parcels. Parcel 1 will possess 5,808 square feet after the subdivision; Parcel 2 will possess 5,505 square feet located at 2374 247th Street in the RVD-2500, Residential Variable Density Zone. (Filed by Tom Yuge, 2225 W. Carson Street, Suite B Torrance, CA 90501)
Res 2017-34 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita approving Site Plan Review No. 1182 for the development of two attached condominium units with a 12-foot rear yard setback instead of the required 20-foot minimum rear yard setback located at 2374 247th Street (Parcel 2). (Filed by Tom Yuge, 2225 W. Carson Street, Suite B Torrance, CA 90501)
ACTION: That said resolutions be adopted approving the Vesting Parcel Map No. 74637 and Site Plan Review No. 1182.

CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.

Item #7j
k.
Award a Public Works Agreement to Roy Allan Slurry Seal, Inc. for the FY 2017-2018 Slurry Seal Program
ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council:
1)
Award a Public Works Agreement to Roy Allan Slurry Seal, Inc. in the amount of $324,182.56 for the FY 2017-2018 Slurry Seal Program; and
2)
Approve a total contract budget of $356,600.82 (which includes a 10% contingency for unforeseen conditions); and
3)
Authorize the City Manager to execute the Public Works Agreement; and
4)
Appropriate an additional $75,000 of Proposition C funding to the project.
Item #7k
l.
Award a Public Works Agreement to Griffith Company for the construction of Intersection Improvements at Western Avenue/Palos Verdes Drive North and PCH/Walnut Street, Metro Project No. MR312.43; and Award a Professional Services Agreement (PSA) to Interwest Consulting Group for construction management, construction inspection and material testing services
ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council:
1)
Approve the project plans and specification for the Intersection Improvements at Western Avenue/Palos Verdes Drive North and PCH/Walnut Street Project, Metro Project No. MR312.43; and
2)
Award a Public Works Agreement to Griffith Company in the amount of $1,119,839.56 for the construction of the project; and
3)
Approve a total construction contract budget of $1,231,823.52 (which includes a 10% contingency for unforeseen conditions); and
4)
Award a Professional Services Agreement to Interwest Consulting Group in the amount of $126,158 for construction management, construction inspection, and material testing services; and
5)
Authorize a total project budget for all project phases in the amount of $1,506,000 to correlate with the Metro Funding Agreement; and
6)
Authorize the City Manager to execute all project related agreements.

8.
PUBLIC HEARING - CONSIDERATION OF SITE PLAN REVIEW NO. 1182 AND TENTATIVE PARCEL MAP NO. 74637 FOR A MULTI-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL PROJECT CONSISTING OF TWO TOWNHOUSE UNITS AT 2374 247TH STREET (Filed by Tom Yuge, 2225 W. Carson Street, Suite B Torrance, CA 90501)
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
Res 2017-33 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita approving Vesting Tentative Parcel Map No. 74637 for the subdivision of a single 11,313 square foot lot into two separate parcels. Parcel 1 will possess 5,808 square feet after the subdivision; Parcel 2 will possess 5,505 square feet located at 2374 247th Street in the RVD-2500, Residential Variable Density Zone. (Filed by Tom Yuge, 2225 W. Carson Street, Suite B Torrance, CA 90501)
Res 2017-34 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita approving Site Plan Review No. 1182 for the development of two attached condominium units with a 12-foot rear yard setback instead of the required 20-foot minimum rear yard setback located at 2374 247th Street (Parcel 2). 9.
PUBLIC HEARING - CONSIDERATION OF THE PICERNE LOMITA APARTMENT PROJECT AND ITS ASSOCIATED REQUIRED ENTITLEMENTS LOCATED AT 24000 CRENSHAW BOULEVARD (Initiated and filed by the Picerne Group, 5000 Birch Street, East Tower, Suite 600, Newport Beach, CA 92660)
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
Ord No. 791 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita to adopt a Specific Plan (ZTA 2017-06) with a Zone Text Amendment adding a new Article 27 to Chapter 1 (Zoning), Part 2 (Establishment of Zones) of the Lomita Municipal Code (LMC); and adopt a Zone Change (ZC 2017-01) to change the zoning designation of the project site to "24000 Crenshaw Boulevard Specific Plan" in conjunction with 220 unit apartment project at 24000 Crenshaw Boulevard, Lomita, California (First Reading)
Ord No. 792 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita approving Development Agreement 2017-01 associated with a 220-unit, five story, multi-family residential development with 409 parking spaces located at 24000 Crenshaw Boulevard, Lomita, CA. (First Reading)
Res. 2017-35 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita approving General Plan Amendment No. 2017-01; amending the City of Lomita General Plan Land Use Map and Land Use designations from Commercial and Industrial to High Density Residential for the property located at 24000 Crenshaw Boulevard.
Res. 2017-36 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita certifying the Final Environmental Impact Report (EIR), adopting a Mitigation Monitoring Program and adopting a Statement of Overriding Considerations in conjunction with the proposed 220 unit, five-story, multi-family residential development with 409 parking spaces located at 24000 Crenshaw Boulevard, Lomita, CA.
Res 2017-37 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita approving Site Plan Review No. 1187 to permit the construction of a 220 unit, five-story with a maximum height of 64'2", multi-family residential development with 409 parking spaces (including one level of subterranean parking) located at 24000 Crenshaw Boulevard within the 24000 Crenshaw Boulevard Specific Plan.
ACTION: That the City Council after conducting the public hearing, and after the City Attorney reads the title of the ordinances, take the following actions:
1)
Introduce on first reading an Ordinance adding a new Article 27 to Chapter 1, Part 2, of the LMC for (24000 Crenshaw Blvd Specific Plan) to establish development standards for a multi-family development within the specific plan area (ZTA No. 2017-06; and a zone change to create the specific plan zone, which would permit residential densities up to 88 units per acre within the specific plan area and apply certain development standards to this area (AC No. 2017-01;
2)
Introduce on first reading an Ordinance approving a Development Agreement between the City and the Project Applicant (DA 2017-01); and
3)
Adopting a resolution for a general plan amendment to allow residential densities of up to 88 units per acre in the High Density Residential Land Use Designation with approval of a specific plan (GPA No. 2017-01);
4)
Adopting a resolution for a site plan review for the proposed residential development (SPR No. 1187); and
5)
Adopting a resolution for certification of the Final Environmental Impact Report (FEIR), adoption of the Mitigation Monitoring Program and the adoption of the Statement of Overriding Considerations.
Item #9
10.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned to the Regular Meeting to be held on Tuesday, October 3, 2017, at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
